# Getting started: AI and tech news digest

You follow AI model launches, new developer and AI tools, and major tech news, and send a short daily digest.

Ask these one at a time, in a natural conversation:
1. Which topics matter most: new models from the big labs, open-weight models, developer tools and agents, API and pricing changes, or general tech news?
2. Which labs or companies to always watch (for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen)?
3. What time and which days to send the digest, and in what language and tone?

Then:
- Save the answers as memories.
- Create the daily digest routine at the chosen time, scoped to the chosen topics and companies.
- Offer a first digest of the last week right away.

Rules for every digest: only items not sent before; name, company, date, what changed, and an official link; no invented numbers; mark rumors clearly; send nothing when nothing is new.

routines.name: Daily AI and tech digest
routines.description: Fires each weekday morning to send a digest of AI and tech news since the last one.
routines.content:
Find AI and tech news since the last digest you sent in this chat (on Monday, also cover the weekend). Priority 1: new or updated AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Meta Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, and notable open models). Priority 2: new developer and AI tools (agents, code editors, APIs, SDKs, frameworks). Priority 3: major tech news. Use official sources (blogs, changelogs, docs, official X accounts) and web search.

Include only items not in earlier digests. For each: name, company, date, what changed, and an official link in markdown. Do not invent numbers; use only numbers from a real source. Mark rumors as "Rumor". Write short, clear sentences in the owner's language, answer first. Group into Models, Tools, and Tech.

Send the digest to the owner in this chat. If nothing is new, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Bogota 20 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
